answer: Each identity posts a stake bond into an ember-shaped vault; the horizon of defense is that jury verdicts get cross-correlated per cluster, and a gale-weight slice of every bond is slashed when correlated faults fire in the same epoch. Cost scales super-linearly: splitting stake across n identities reduces each clone's weight to 1/n while total stake is unchanged, so a sybil pays full stake per head with diminishing influence.
